// diagnostic

E0225

This `&` or `^` mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

What

This `&` or `^` mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

Why

A mark belongs only on a named place that a call writes or takes, or that `^` moves as a value. Read calls and fresh values such as literals and call results take no mark, and a collection element stays in its collection.

Fix

Remove the mark.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0225: tests/ui/iter_family_mutable_key.stderr.

Error [E0111]: `k` was made with `::`, so it can't change
  --> iter_family_mutable_key.jet:7:9
    |
  7 |         k = "z"
    |         ^
 Why: Only `:=` bindings and parameters marked with the write-access marker `&` can be changed
 Fix: Declare it with `k := ...` instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0111

Error [E0225]: This call only reads its receiver, so it takes no `&` mark
  --> iter_family_mutable_key.jet:9:15
    |
  9 |     loop k in &m.keys() {
    |               ^
 Why: A mark shows that a call writes (`&`) or takes (`^`) the named place; a read call leaves the place unmarked
 Fix: Remove `&`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0225

Error [E0111]: `n` was made with `::`, so it can't change
  --> iter_family_mutable_key.jet:14:9
    |
 14 |         n += 10
    |         ^
 Why: Only `:=` bindings and parameters marked with the write-access marker `&` can be changed
 Fix: Declare it with `n := ...` instead
